anomalies.observed: Both ground pins of each isolated CAN transceiver, GND1 and GND2, are connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: GND1 and GND2 must remain on separate ground domains for the CAN interfaces to provide galvanic isolation, as intended by the specification.
anomalies.impact: The shared ground connection bypasses the transceivers' galvanic isolation, so the CAN buses are not isolated and may conduct ground disturbances or faults into the motherboard ground.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is present: both CAN transceivers’ isolated-side and logic-side grounds are tied to the same GND net, defeating the specified galvanic isolation.
